content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've connected my [product_name] to a third-party HMI panel from [company_name]. I'm trying to set setpoints on the HMI and transfer them to the [product_name] so I can compare the setpoint with the current value. Is there a way to compare values such as Integer or Float within the [product_name]? It looks like only an analog comparator function is available. Could someone assist? Thank you.

The [product_name] handles analog values as integers, which is why there is only an analog comparator. It can't directly compare floating point (32-bit) values; these can only be processed by converting them using an F/I converter.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wants to compare numeric setpoints, including floats, received from a third-party HMI with values in a [product_name] device. The device only supports analog (integer) comparisons natively, and does not offer direct comparison for floating-point values. Floats require conversion before any processing, which can affect integration with external HMIs needing accurate float value operations.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] device to allow direct comparison of both integer and floating-point values.
